description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with HashiCorp Vault to fetch kubeconfig data, including URL construction, payload extraction, and logging helpers.

methods.name: List[str] _vault_candidate_urls(vault_addr: str, secret_path: str)
methods.description: Builds potential URLs for accessing Vault secrets based on the provided address and secret path.

methods.name: str _extract_kubeconfig_from_payload(payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Extracts kubeconfig data from different possible payload structures returned by Vault.

methods.name: None _log_vault_start(logger: logging.Logger, url: str, timeout: float)
methods.description: Logs the start of a Vault request with context information.

methods.name: None _log_vault_end(logger: logging.Logger, status_code: int)
methods.description: Logs the completion of a Vault request with status information.

methods.name: None _log_vault_error(logger: logging.Logger, url: str, exc: Exception)
methods.description: Logs an error encountered during a Vault request.

methods.name: str fetch_kubeconfig_from_vault(vault_addr: str, token: str, secret_path: str, timeout: float = 8.0)
methods.description: Public function to fetch kubeconfig data from Vault by trying multiple URL formats and handling errors.

ctags.name: _log_vault_error
ctags.pattern: /^def _log_vault_error(logger: logging.Logger, url: str, exc: Exception) -> None:$/

ctags.name: _log_vault_start
ctags.pattern: /^def _log_vault_start(logger: logging.Logger, url: str, timeout: float) -> None:$/

ctags.name: fetch_kubeconfig_from_vault
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_kubeconfig_from_vault(vault_addr: str, token: str, secret_path: str, timeout: float = /
ctags.signature: (vault_addr: str, token: str, secret_path: str, timeout: float = 8.0)
